name: Green Rain Energy Holdings Inc.
summary: Green Rain Energy Holdings Inc. is dedicated to pioneering and marketing various alternative energy solutions. Their work encompasses advancements in wind power as well as the repurposing of dormant oil wells. A core offering is the proprietary, patent-pending exoPOWER windTURBINE System, specifically engineered to boost the efficiency of wind energy generation. This company, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Portland, Oregon, began operating under its current name, Green Rain Energy Holdings Inc., in June 2025, following its earlier identity as The Now Corporation.
